title: More checks in image generation
summary:
Image generation gained more safety checks, feed events gained maturity data, and Pal Chat joined the community project listings.

Image prompts gained LlamaGuard classification alongside the existing image checks. Prohibited requests can be rejected, and prompt enhancement now has a fallback when language detection fails.

Feed listeners excluding NSFW content now account for additional maturity flags. The end_generating event gained a nested maturity field and no longer includes originalPrompt; LlamaGuard 7B AWQ was also added as a safety model in the text API.

The README and website now list Pal Chat, an iOS app by @pallavmac that puts Pollinations models and other LLMs in one chat interface.

highlights.title: Maturity data in feed events
highlights.text: The `end_generating` feed event now includes a nested `maturity` field, giving feed builders more information for content filtering.
